record.one_liner: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) for sending and receiving WhatsApp messages from a business phone number.
record.auth_notes: Direct developers use a System User access token (static, long-lived bearer token sent as Authorization header). Tech Providers and solution partners use Business Integration System User tokens. The docs also mention OAuth-based user access tokens generated from the App Dashboard; I did not fully verify that flow, so auth_methods is medium confidence.
record.access_notes: Developers get a test phone number and can send test messages with a system user token before any production approval. Production use requires a business portfolio and possibly App Review; that is captured in verdict.
record.api_notes: Cloud API (Graph API, v23.0 in examples), Marketing Messages API and Business Management API are documented on the platform overview.
record.blocker_notes: Test-number sandbox works self-serve. Production messaging needs business verification and an App Review submission where the use case requires it. The official WhatsApp Business Tools MCP is in beta and needs Meta developer account sign-in.

evidence.quote: If you are a direct developer, meaning only you or your business accesses your own data, use a System User access token.
